lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Well, now that you're here,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ask me whatever you want.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Nothing's off limits.
I want to know more about you.
Tell me more about this organization of yours.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'm the head of Hedonia.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'm also part of the Underworld Queen.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And, lest we forget,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'm also the woman who recently spent a few nights at your place.
Let's try and stay on topic.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Fine, if you insist.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I think you already knew all of that, however.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Perhaps I should elaborate some more?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I was born in Ephialtes, the Outer Rim's entertainment district.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: My mother worked there. My father was a feckless Sovereign.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I never got to meet him. I don't even know what he looks like. My mother died a long time ago.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're probably wondering why I'm telling you all this.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're a hotshot commander.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're on the fast track to becoming a member of the upper crust yourself.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If you ever come across someone you suspect may be my father, I want you to notify me.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll make sure he gets his comeuppance.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ah, so you're curious about Hedonia?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Just when you're about to put them out of your mind, there they are, plastered on the front page for some crime they've committed.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: More so than that though, they tend to shake up the underworld.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: In actuality, they're rather utilitarian in their aims.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: For example, we've taken down organizations that try and make a profit by illegally selling human corpses.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If we force them to pony up half their money to us for protection,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: then that means less money is used for their own illicit activities.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: That way, we diminish the impact these unseemly organizations have on society, to the point where they don't necessarily need to be wiped out.
I think I understand.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: That's more or less how Hedonia works.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: We fight fire with fire.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If you ask me, it makes way more sense how Sakura and Moran do it, as it's much more clear-cut.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Those two place more emphasis on what they consider deterrence.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: For me, if someone needs to be killed, I'm more than happy to oblige.
I've been meaning to ask:
How can you kill humans if you're a Nikke?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: A fair question.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: The inhibitors on members of the Underworld Queen are less restrictive.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It's a lot like... what's their name again... Oh yeah, Perilous Siege.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If we're meant to keep the underworld in check, it wouldn't make sense to hamstring us.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Having said that, it doesn't mean we can go around shooting people willy-nilly.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Like any heroic figure opposed to taking life, I myself must be obliged to abide by certain rules and regulations.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: As a result, I do everything within my power to ensure that whoever I've got in my sights remains alive.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I also have a little workaround with my subordinates.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: All I've got to do is sic them on the target, and bam: two shots to the body and one to the head.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: After all, it's much easier for a human to kill a fellow human.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: All right, now it's my turn.
You've got something you want to ask me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: More than a few, actually. I've got a list.
All right, what's near the top then?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hmm, let's see...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You got a girlfriend?
Not at the moment.
That's... a secret.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You want one?
I've never given it much consideration.
I suppose it'd be nice.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Either way, it's not completely out of the question, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: All right, cool.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Usually, when a man says that,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: they're single, but they just want to let someone down easily.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Or, they do in fact have a girlfriend, and they're trying to be faithful.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: So, which is it in your case, Mister?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It doesn't really make a difference.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I can steal you away if I want.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: All right, back to you.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What else are you curious about?
What exactly was the reason for asking me that question just now?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: There's an honest answer and a diplomatic answer.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Which do you want?
The honest answer.
The diplomatic answer.
Rosanna playfully tugs at the breast pocket of my shirt.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Because I like what's underneath this.
Excuse me?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Remember?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: When you came running out of the shower?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I liked what I saw. It's a shame all I could do was look instead of touch.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I can see it now: you carefully styling your hair so that every strand is in place,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: and then me making it all messy again with my hands. Wouldn't that be fun?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: However, we'd have to be an item for that to be okay.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Otherwise, it'd be crossing the line, even by my fairly libertine standards.
If you ask me, you've harassed me plenty already.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ha! Don't be such a prude. This isn't even close to harassment.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I was putting your life in danger by getting you mixed up in my personal affairs.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Despite that, you were still worried about me and kept a brave face all the while.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I suppose that's the most succinct way of putting it.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Naturally, I had my misgivings about getting closer to you,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: but since I've already failed at keeping a certain distance between us,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I thought I might as well go all in and shower you with affection.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: However, I could only really do that if we're an item. Otherwise, it could be considered harassment.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It'd be crossing the line, even for me.
In what world is that considered a diplomatic answer?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It is by my standards.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: My turn again.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What are your thoughts on hooking up with me?
Pfft!
I do a spit take.
Come again?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You heard me.
If I say yes, then what happens?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Not sure. To start off, I suppose you'd have to spend the night with me.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But it wouldn't be like the past few days at your place.
*swoosh*
I choke on my water and struggle to keep from spitting it all out again.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Going forward...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll protect you. Forever and ever.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Whether it's the Outer Rim, or the Ark.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: As long as it's somewhere I can reach you, no one will harass you for the rest of your days.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Too maudlin?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Yeah, I don't think it suits me either.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It'd be one thing if I was a poet, composing a sonnet to her beloved.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But I'm Rosanna. The leader of Hedonia. My name inspires fear in the hearts of men.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: For me to go out of my way to protect someone,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: all because of how I feel about them...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: is unprecedented.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And if you turn me down after I've just opened up to you,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: then you'll be the first to make a fool of me as well.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Well? What's your answer?
Let's give it a shot.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: In that case, how about we head to my place?
Right now?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: That's what people who are together do, isn't it?
Sure, but it's only the first day...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Moving too quickly for you?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Fine, how about tomorrow?
Why are you in such a hurry?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'm greedy.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Whatever I want, I get.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You're someone who spends their days in rarified air.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I didn't want you to get hurt because of me, so I tried my best to drive you away.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But you insist on stepping into the shadows of your own accord.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If I can't stop you, why should I hold back any longer?
Fine. Tomorrow it is.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Splendid!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: This is gonna be fantastic.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Best I bid you ado, before I end up changing my mind.
Rosanna motions somewhere behind me, and her subordinates draw close.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: You called, Boss?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Escort this man

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: back to his house.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Treat him as you would treat me.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: As for you, Mister,

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I expect you to be prepared when we meet tomorrow.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'd like this to unfold as naturally as possible.
I head outside, waving goodbye to Rosanna as I leave.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Where to, {AccountData.NickName}?
The Outpost's command center.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Very well. We'll be taking the boss's vehicle.
She has her own car?

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Yes. Hedonia is a rather affluent organization.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Although I must admit, having our own vehicle does put a target on our backs...
*Zing*

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: The Boss is more tenacious than anyone I've ever known.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: It never bodes well for anyone foolish enough to go up against her.
*Beep*
The gang member unlocks the car door and holds it open.

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Go ahead, s...
*Tudududu*

lines.speaker: hedonian
lines.text: Argh!!
The Hedonia member falls to the ground.
Grab his gun and fire back at the unseen attackers.
Run back into the restaurant.
*Boom*
For a moment, all is quiet.
*Tudududu*
The silence is broken by an endless stream of gunshots.
Run away from the gun shots.
I leap behind the car.
For a moment, all is quiet. Seizing the opportunity, I make a beeline for the restaurant.
*Tudududu*
An endless stream of gunshots erupts from behind me.
*Bang bang*
A burning sensation spreads over my body.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: waitress
lines.text: Everybody, get down... Ahhhh!

lines.speaker: waitress
lines.text: Help! Someone call the A.C.P.U.!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ... Mister.
